company_name: Henan Xinlianxin Shenleng Energy Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company produces high-purity methane, a critical gas used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Henan Xinlianxin Shenleng Energy Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of high-purity methane (CH₄) using proprietary cryogenic distillation technology, achieving a purity level of 99.9999%. This product is essential for advanced chip manufacturing and packaging, with a stable supply chain supporting major industry players like TSMC and YMTC.
capabilities: Supply chain management for semiconductor gases

regional_presence.China: The company has established a stable supply chain within China, serving major semiconductor manufacturers.
